[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

[[Category:Killycurragh Townland, Derryloran Parish, County Tyrone]]
== Biography ==
Julia was born 19 June 1840. Her parents were George and Eleanor of Killycurragh.
<ref>13 Sep 1840 || 19 Jun 1840 || Julia GLASGOW || George/Eleanor || Killycurragh || Farmer || CPB.  [[Space:The_Parish_Registers_of_Derryloran_parish_church|The Parish Registers of Derryloran parish church]] VOL1</ref>

== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-2044]] is assessed at 57% (possible). Julia’s held baptism account expressly names George and Eleanor of Killycurragh. The selected George later died in nearby Ballynagilly, but no held record connects that specific man to Eleanor or Julia; rarity is supportive rather than identifying.

Confidence concerns this recorded child and the selected father as identified by the held family evidence; maternity and the father’s upstream ancestry are separate.

Next useful test: Locate the 1840 baptism original and search George/Eleanor’s marriage or linked estate.

Source basis already held: [https://civilrecords.irishgenealogy.ie/churchrecords/details-civil/1b2a293583270 George Glasgow, 1893, Cookstown, 80 (https://civilrecords.irishgenealogy.ie/churchrecords/details-civil/1b2a293583270) at Irish Civil Registration - Deaths]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.


No other baptisms in the register found to a father George Glasgow.

The linked father died at a neighbouring townland and we have found no mentions of any other George Glasgow of this generation. But this is very tentative, as her father might have been a different George who died.

Not found in civil registration ; e.g. may have died young or emigrated. The tentative brother [[Glasgow-2025|James Charles Glasgow (abt.1841-1917)]] married in Philadelphia, although then returned to Killycurragh.
